title: Coordinate mobile file access without relying on advisory locks
goal: Replace FileShare-based coordination on iOS and tvOS when default advisory locking is disabled, keeping in-process ownership separate from extension or cross-process coordination.

selectionNotes: Replace FileShare-based coordination on iOS and tvOS when default advisory locking is disabled, keeping in-process ownership separate from extension or cross-process coordination.
